comments.text: Living in Unalaska must be a completely different experience from anywhere on the mainland. Being surrounded by the ocean, volcanic mountains, and wildlife while dealing with isolation and harsh weather takes a special kind of strength. I’d love to hear from locals about what makes this place feel like home.
